hapHeadConsistency.note: BUILD_INFO matched the verification HEAD before the final source/report commit. The final commit necessarily creates a one-commit difference because BUILD_INFO contains a commit hash.

rootCause: DocumentUploadPage could send a synthetic product-* planId, causing backend upload 500 responses that Harmony request.uploadFile surfaced as code 17 / Http protocol error.
fixes: Unified TestLab, file picker, and camera upload objects with NormalizedUploadFile.
Copied picker and camera inputs into cache and verified non-empty files before upload.
Filtered synthetic planId values while preserving productId.
Kept upload data aligned to backend DTO fields.
Added sanitized manual upload failure details and copyable summaries.
Added a small-file multipart fallback for request.uploadFile code 17 failures.
Extended device QA to verify DocumentUploadPage manual upload paths.
remainingManualTest: Take one physical photo through the MatePad system camera from DocumentUploadPage and upload it once.
